description: The bar chart, titled "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the effect of various linguistic features on different models, with the vertical axis labeled "effect" ranging from 0 to 20 and the horizontal axis showing four categories: "case," "gender," "number," and "tense." Each category contains a group of six bars, representing six distinct models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red), as indicated by the legend. The bars are grouped by category, with each model's bar shown in its respective color. Error bars, representing standard deviation, are present for each bar. In the "case" category, the mBERT-B₂ (light red) and XLM-B₂ (dark red) models exhibit the highest effects, with values around 12 and 11 respectively, while the mBERT-L₂ (light blue) and XLM-L₂ (dark blue) models show lower effects, around 6 and 5. In the "gender" category, the mBERT-B₂ (light red) and XLM-B₂ (dark red) models again show the highest effects, with values around 4 and 3. In the "number" category, the mBERT-B₂ (light red) and XLM-B₂ (dark red) models have the highest effects, with values around 3 and 2. In the "tense" category, all models show very low effects, with values close to 0. The chart shows that the mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ models generally have higher effects across the different linguistic features compared to the other models.
